verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only an Adyen MCP server, which lets external LLM clients call Adyen. Nothing shows Adyen Risk Management acting as an MCP client that can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. Server-side MCP is a different role and earns no credit for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
